items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I asked him if he knew, I don’t know, one of the lines [to] “Subconscious” maybe, and he stood in the corner and went through it okay.

ctx.x: For example there are a few records that I haven’t heard that I would actually love to. One record you did a few years ago with Mark Turner, the young tenor player for Chesky.
